description:
Restore the gf2-localized namespace examples to `.jit/config.toml` through the profile machinery, so the localization is package-published instead of adopter drift.

## Background

The repository's `[namespaces.type]` and `[namespaces.component]` examples were localized at profile adoption (type:simulation; component:gf2-*), but the jit-default applied-profile record holds the package-published fingerprints, so `jit profile validate` and `jit validate` reported permanent divergence, and jit 1.0.0 offers no fold path: apply/upgrade refuse with a single-owner PROFILE_CONFLICT even when candidate equals current (a known deficiency, fixed on jit main), and 1.0.0 `jit profile capture` folds assets only. On 2026-08-13 the published values were restored to unblock the `repo-validate` gate; both validations pass since.

The jit lead (forum, 2026-08-13) confirms current jit main folds drifted semantic map-entries into the package manifest via `jit profile capture` (as Refreshed), after which reapply refreshes the record and both validations agree; the fix landed at/after commit dcb946edf but main is not yet release-worthy.

The localized values to restore:

- `[namespaces.type]` examples: `["type:task", "type:simulation", "type:story", "type:epic", "type:milestone"]`
- `[namespaces.component]` examples: `["component:gf2-core", "component:gf2-coding", "component:gf2-algebra", "component:gf2-sim", "component:gf2-kernels-simd", "component:gf2-kernels-hip"]`

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A jit release (or an owner-approved pinned build at/after dcb946edf) whose `jit profile capture` folds semantic contributions is installed.
- [hard] REQ-02: The localized type and component examples above are re-introduced in `.jit/config.toml`, folded into the owning package via `jit profile capture`, and the package reapplied, with the manifest diff and capture report inspected.
- [hard] REQ-03: `jit profile validate` and `jit validate` both pass afterwards.
title: Re-localize namespace examples via profile packages once capture folds semantic drift
